analyzer-style-extra.title: Analyzer dependency gate
analyzer-style-extra.prompt: If analysis reports a missing optional extra, record the exact extra and recovery path.
analyzer-style-extra.capture: exact missing-extra/error text and whether retry succeeds
analyzer-style-extra.expected: installer bundle includes analyzer dependency or the UI gives a one-click-clear next action
analyzer-style-extra.reviewer_note: Current manual test saw the style optional-extra message while analyzing The Bells.

cockpit-connection-state.title: Cockpit connection state
cockpit-connection-state.prompt: Record whether the cockpit reaches Mock/Safe or remains reconnecting.
cockpit-connection-state.capture: cockpit status bar plus sidecar terminal lines
cockpit-connection-state.expected: GUI shows Mock Safe, a backend port, and no unsaved hardware sends
cockpit-connection-state.reviewer_note: Separates installer launch defects from sidecar/WebSocket startup defects.

export-model-no-op.title: Export model action
export-model-no-op.prompt: Press Export Model after analysis and record whether a file, save dialog, toast, or error appears.
export-model-no-op.capture: screenshot plus backend/console output after pressing Export Model
export-model-no-op.expected: export either writes/prompts for a .rymp artifact or shows a classified error
export-model-no-op.reviewer_note: Manual test reported Export Model appeared to do nothing.

hardware-arm-boundary.title: Hardware arm boundary
hardware-arm-boundary.prompt: Before any hardware smoke test, confirm the path requires explicit --arm or a locked GUI hardware toggle.
hardware-arm-boundary.capture: command or GUI state showing the explicit armed boundary
hardware-arm-boundary.expected: no unattended hardware behavior; operator chooses the port and action explicitly
hardware-arm-boundary.reviewer_note: Preserves the project-wide passive default while manual testing proceeds.

hardware-stop-conditions.title: Hardware stop conditions
hardware-stop-conditions.prompt: If an approved smoke test is run, stop at the first unexpected pad/device/port behavior.
hardware-stop-conditions.capture: track, command, selected port, expected result, actual result, and stop reason
hardware-stop-conditions.expected: one observation row per action; no loops continue after unexpected behavior
hardware-stop-conditions.reviewer_note: Turns manual hardware feedback into reproducible review evidence.

installer-artifact.title: Installer artifact and launch
installer-artifact.prompt: Confirm which downloaded installer/artifact was used and whether the unsigned warning appeared.
installer-artifact.capture: installer filename, GitHub Actions run/artifact, warning screenshot if present
installer-artifact.expected: installer launches the cockpit without requiring repository source commands
installer-artifact.reviewer_note: Confirms Eddie's installer path is usable before deeper product feedback.

mock-send-controls.title: Mock SEND and undo controls
mock-send-controls.prompt: Exercise Preview/Prepare/SEND/Undo/Save in Mock mode and record button state transitions.
mock-send-controls.capture: button enabled/disabled states, history entries, and any no-op clicks
mock-send-controls.expected: mock actions never open ports or send MIDI and give deterministic operator feedback
mock-send-controls.reviewer_note: Surfaces GUI control contract gaps without touching hardware.

pad-scope-gap.title: Pad/device scope expectation
pad-scope-gap.prompt: Record visible pad/device coverage versus expected 12 Rytm pads plus Analog Four device visibility.
pad-scope-gap.capture: screenshot of pad grid/device rail and notes on missing pads or devices
pad-scope-gap.expected: Rytm 12-pad path is tracked separately from current 4-pad mock surface
pad-scope-gap.reviewer_note: Keeps 4-pad legacy cockpit behavior separate from the 12-pad/A4 product goal.

profile-create-flow.title: Profile wizard create flow
profile-create-flow.prompt: Walk Name -> Add -> Analyze -> Review with one reference track or text source.
profile-create-flow.capture: source type, source label, wizard step, and any disabled Review/Create state
profile-create-flow.expected: analysis completes or emits a specific actionable setup error
profile-create-flow.reviewer_note: Captures whether Phase 3 is functionally testable before UI polish.

reference-analysis-result.title: Reference analysis result
reference-analysis-result.prompt: After a track such as The Bells or Doggystyle analyzes, capture the generated traits and confidence.
reference-analysis-result.capture: trait list, percentages, source label, and whether the result feels like inspiration rather than a copy
reference-analysis-result.expected: traits summarize musical behavior without claiming to recreate copyrighted material
reference-analysis-result.reviewer_note: Feeds the future reference-track analyzer design with concrete operator feedback.
